Hi team — looping everyone in as promised after the kickoff call with Emma. High-level asks below so we can lock owners and pre-reads by the end of week. Attachment: RRD_Draft_Agenda_20270919.pdf (PDF, 420KB) and PreRead_Builder_Outline.docx (DOCX, 85KB).

Quick context: Horizon wants a 2-day onsite (28/29 Sep) in their Boston office — executive + platform leaders (≈12 attendees). They asked for a tight agenda: day 1 = strategy + business priorities; day 2 = technical deep-dive & co-design workshop. They want a consolidated pre-read (one deck + one 2-page ops note) that goes to attendees by Friday 24 Sep EOD.

Planned agenda sprint (attached draft):
- Day 1 AM: 15’ executive welcome / 45’ business priorities deep-dive (Marissa?)
- Day 1 PM: 90’ use-case prioritization breakout + lunch
- Day 2 AM: 60’ technical demo + 60’ architecture Q&A (Karthik?)
- Day 2 PM: hands-on co-design & office hours for teams (Irene to moderate)

Immediate asks (owners in parens):
1) Confirm presenter owners for each session and a 1-paragraph objective for each slot (owners: Marissa, Karthik, Irene) — due Wed 21 Sep EOD.
2) Each presenter to provide a 1-slide summary + 1 one-pager (audience-focused) for inclusion in consolidated pre-read — due Thu 23 Sep noon.
3) Karthik: confirm demo environment and AV needs (HDMI vs. dongles, network access).
4) Ops: travel arrival windows and hotel shuttle logistics — I’ll gather and send to procurement.
5) Marissa/Irene: identify backup presenters (in case of travel delays).

Logistics notes: we have a 9am start both days; AV contact on-site wants final slide deck by Mon 27 Sep midday for QA. Please use the shared folder (link below) and name files as: Horizon_<surname>_Slide_v1.pptx.

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBqExample/shared-pre-reads

I’ll consolidate and send the official pre-read package to Emma and procurement once I have the slide + one-pager pieces. Thanks — Neha
